versions.name: Camp Vandeventer
versions.summary: Greater St. Louis Area Council camp in Waterloo, Illinois, hosting Cub Adventure Camp and Cub Scout day camp, with a pool, shooting ranges, fishing, trails, and rappelling.

sources.citation: Community correction via Camp Finder Suggest-a-Correction form; submitted by a visitor 2026-08-14 (submission bZ6Z9y2), kept anonymous at submitter request. Greater St. Louis Area Council voted in 2020 to end operations and sell the property; submitter reports the sale completed (submitter's archive source was not re-fetchable at triage time).

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types.
